title: STREET YEET
description: Walk a low-poly city block, clear goofy levels, grab power-ups, and send anything a hilariously unrealistic distance with a swappable arsenal.
controls: WASD or arrow keys to walk, Shift to run
Mouse to look around (click to grab the mouse), Q and E to turn the camera
Click or Space to swing; hold to charge a bigger yeet
1-4 or the scroll wheel to swap weapons. More unlock as you clear levels
Walk into glowing pickups: turbo sneakers, mega yeet, slow-mo, and a magnet
On touch screens, drag left to walk, drag right to look, hold YEET to charge, and tap SWAP to change weapons
